description: Main source file for Bluetooth audio recording to WAV file, including callback implementations, state management, and main execution logic.

methods.name: on_configure_sink
methods.description: Configures the sink with the provided audio format, caching parameters.

methods.name: on_acquire_sink
methods.description: Handles acquisition of the sink, creates WAV file and writes header.

methods.name: on_relinquish_sink
methods.description: Handles relinquishing the sink, finalizes WAV file by updating header and closing file.

methods.name: on_change_sink_speed
methods.description: Handles change in sink speed, controls recording state.

methods.name: on_get_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns elapsed recording time in milliseconds.

methods.name: on_get_delay
methods.description: Returns delay in samples, always zero for disk writer.

methods.name: on_frame_received
methods.description: Processes received audio frames, writes to file if recording.

methods.name: state_changed
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth source state changes, logs current state.

methods.name: operational_state_update
methods.description: Callback for operational state updates, registers or unregisters callbacks.

methods.name: ctrl_c_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to set user_break flag.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function managing Bluetooth audio connection, recording loop, and cleanup.
